# @jpisgeek/dashboard-homelab

Normalizes scoped execution output from the local @jpisgeek/netdata,
@jpisgeek/truenas, and @jpisgeek/firewalla collectors into the versioned,
provider-neutral dashboard bundle contract. Every record is validated before
use, and missing, stale, partial, rejected, and unauthorized observations do not
become healthy values or convenient zeros.

**Version** `2026.08.25.1` · **License** MIT · **Source**
https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/tree/main/dashboard-homelab

## Install

```
swamp extension pull @jpisgeek/dashboard-homelab
```

## Example

```yaml
# Require this report on any supported collector definition.
reports:
  require:
    - "@jpisgeek/dashboard-homelab"

# After the collector method runs, pass its exact stored JSON artifact:
globalArguments:
  bundles:
    - ${{ data.latest("netdata", "report-jpisgeek-dashboard-homelab-json").attributes }}
```

## Caveats

This package observes only the data handles produced by the collector execution
it is attached to. Firewalla filtered runs declare filtered coverage. TrueNAS
alerts remain independent from certificate exceptions because the current alert
resource exposes no stable certificate identity. The report never guesses a
match from message text or list order.

## Security

The report performs no network, process, environment, or vault operations. It
reads only scoped Swamp execution data through the public report context. Source
validation errors contain resource names and validation classes, not source
payloads. Bundle contents are classified operational and may include host, pool,
mount, certificate, machine, and network names; protect rendered dashboards
accordingly.

See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for the release gates every version passes before it reaches the registry.
